title: Business events scheduled for Thursday
text:
Business events scheduled for Thursday Posted on Wednesday, August 8th, 2018 By The Associated Press
Major business and economic events scheduled for Thursday:
WASHINGTON — Labor Department releases the Producer Price Index for July, 8:30 a.m.
WASHINGTON — Commerce Department releases wholesale trade inventories for June, 10 a.m.
